idea.title: The 5-line caption that gets messages
idea.angle: Most captions say 'beautiful, spacious, DM for price'. I walk through the five lines (hook, basics, three highlights, price and location, one action) and why each one matters.
idea.hook: THE CAPTION THAT GETS BUYERS TO MESSAGE

slides.heading: THE CAPTION THAT GETS BUYERS TO **MESSAGE**
slides.body: Five lines. Same order every time. No guesswork.

slides.heading: "DM FOR PRICE" GETS **IGNORED**
slides.body: Most captions say beautiful, spacious, DM for price. The buyer learns nothing. People who have to ask for the basics often don't bother.

slides.heading: THE **5-LINE** CAPTION
bullets: Hook: the standout feature and area.
Basics: bedrooms, bathrooms, sale or rent.
Highlights: three things buyers care about.
One action: one keyword or one link.

slides.heading: SHOW THE **PRICE**
slides.body: I know it feels risky. But a price filters out time-wasters. The people who message you already know it fits.

slides.heading: GIVE **ONE** ACTION, NOT THREE
slides.body: One keyword or one WhatsApp link. Tip: use a new keyword for each listing, like TOUR1 and TOUR2. Then you know which home they mean.

slides.heading: SAME HOUSE. **BETTER** CAPTION.
slides.body:
Before: Beautiful house for sale. Very nice and spacious. DM for more info and price.
After: Pool, garden and quiet street, close to schools.
4 bedrooms · 4 bathrooms · for sale
✓ Gated, 24-hour security
✓ Fitted kitchen
✓ 5 minutes to the main road
[Price] · [Area, City]
DM "TOUR" to book a viewing.

slides.heading: Same five lines. Every listing. No more guessing.
slides.body: Save the template. Swap in the details each time.

caption:
Your caption is the reason buyers message you, or scroll past.

"DM for price" tells them nothing.
Use the same five lines every time: hook, basics, three highlights, price and location, one action.
Swipe to see a weak caption turned into one that gets messages.
